description: This file defines the RelatedProduct class, which extends the Product class and adds a relationship type property indicating the type of relation such as RELATED_ITEM or BUNDLED_ITEM.

classes.name: RelatedProduct
classes.description: A Java class representing a related product entity with a relationship type and serialization capabilities.

methods.name: setRelationShipType
methods.description: Sets the type of relationship for this related product.

methods.name: getRelationShipType
methods.description: Retrieves the relationship type of this related product.
